rf.objective: mean clipped MAE over the provided three training CV folds
rf.encoding: log2 leaf size, linear feature fraction, ordered index of depth choices; each axis normalized to [0,1]

clusters.initialization: same kmeans++ centers for e-means and Lloyd, one initialization per seed
clusters.features: RGB54; variance removal and scaling fitted on training only
clusters.limit: same passes and starts do not imply equal work; report time and final squared-distance loss. No large-scale speedup claim.

review.models: frozen handoff RF/GP and frozen handoff e-means K16; keeps policy comparison independent of new RF tuning
review.sigma_mixture: existing queue: 20% audit; of remaining priority slots 3/4 low GP mean, rest largest remaining sigma; exact integer allocation follows review_queue
review.lcb: rank raw GP mean minus 1 observation sigma; uncalibrated heuristic
review.rounding: static ceil(n*p); chronological cumulative ceil(n_seen*p) per run, carry differences across windows
review.dedup: static first sample ID per decoded pixel; stream first occurrence per run
review.primary_contrast: gp_sigma_audit versus gp_mean_audit at 10%, with identical pool/window/budget/audit fraction/seed
review.limit: all cohorts previously inspected; descriptive diagnostics, no policy tuning using these labels
